# FDG5023

> CONSIDER using a property if the member represents a logical attribute of the type.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.1.3 Choosing Between Properties and Methods.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: verified

Not an analyzer candidate: whether a member is a logical attribute of the type is a matter of meaning. CA1024 is mapped to FDG5024.

## From the book

For example, `Button.Color` is a property because color is an attribute of a button.
